ayudaAgregar: Upload a video from your computer (MP4, MOV or WebM, up to {mb} MB and 2 minutes) or drop it here
vacio: Add a video on top of the clip: B-roll, a reaction or the product. If it's vertical, it goes full screen.
pantallaCompletaAyuda: Covers the whole clip; whatever doesn't fit is cropped.
pantallaCompletaVertical: This video is vertical: full screen fills the whole clip.
oArrastralo: Drag it on the preview to move it; the corner resizes it.
sinLoop: It doesn't loop: it leaves when the video ends, at the second you choose or at the end of the clip.

sonidosAyuda.SIN_SONIDO: It shows, but you don't hear it.
sonidosAyuda.MEZCLADO: You hear it together with the clip's voice.
sonidosAyuda.SOLO_VIDEO: While it shows, you only hear the video: the clip's voice is muted. Music and effects keep playing.

seVeraEnElRender: Video {n}: this browser can't show it, but it will be in the render
